thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PD #INC-8123 fired — p99 latency > 3s for 'text-generation-prod' route, SLO burn detected (p95 ~500ms -> 1.2s, p99 ~300ms -> 3.4s). Auto-page to eng-oncall.
Sam H: acked PD. I'm on it.
Lee: seeing the same on dashboards — tail spike across eu-west and us-west. Queues up on inference-worker groups; KV cache eviction spikes correlate.
Maria: any recent rollouts?
Sam H: no new rollouts in last 2 hours. Canary looks clean.
Sam H: quick triage commands I'm running:
```bash
# check avg queue length and inflight
curl -sS https://obs.internal/metrics?query=inflight_requests%7Bservice%3D%22inference%22%7D | jq .
kubectl -n inference get hpa --show-stamped
```
Lee: logs show a handful of large-batch requests hitting the longer path — batching latency increase. Also a KV cache thrash for model-v3-quantized-8bit on host pool-05.
Maria: can we route new traffic to fallback model-v2-small while we investigate? fallback still meets quality thresholds for most customers.
Sam H: I can route, but need a quick check on capacity. If we shift traffic we'll spike token costs but reduce latency.
ops-bot: Executing runbook step: scale-up dedicated pool 'prod-dedicate-1' by +2 GPUs (requested by Sam H).
ops-bot: Command: `infra scale-gpu --pool prod-dedicate-1 --add 2 --reason "p99 latency mitigation"`
Sam H: routing change in 30s — using control-plane fast-failover.
```bash
# switch routing policy for route text-generation-prod
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://control-plane.internal/v1/routes/text-generation-prod/route \
  -d '{"policy":"prefer:fallback-v2-small","drain_seconds":45}'
```
Lee: I pushed a temporary limit to batch size for hotpath: `max_batch_tokens=1024` via configmap.
Maria: I'm throttling heavy API keys at the edge (rate-limit reduced to 60rps for tier-enterprise) to protect median latency.
Sam H: initial impact: p95 dropped to ~700ms, p99 trending down to ~1.4s. Good sign.
Grace (SRE): taking notes for postmortem. Are we seeing customer-facing errors?
Sam H: No increased 5xxs in the last 5m, just high tail latency. External synthetic checks show degraded response times for a subset of customers on large prompt workloads.
Maria: Notifying customer success about potential impact to a small set of enterprise customers who run multi-k prompt pipelines.
Sam H: PagerDuty: will escalate to L2 in 15m if p99 > 1.5s persists.
Lee: root causes I'm seeing: 1) sudden hotkey on a KV-backed cache, 2) a long-running background job (batching warm-up) that increased memory pressure -> eviction churn.
Sam H: mitigation checklist status:
- route to fallback model: DONE
- scale GPUs +2: IN PROGRESS (ops-bot triggered)
- reduce batch size on hotpath: DONE
- throttle large keys: DONE
- warm-up KV cache for fallback variant: RUNNING

ops-bot: scale-up completed: prod-dedicate-1 +2 GPUs (nvidia-a10). Autoscaler adjustments will persist for 10m.
Sam H: p99 now ~950ms, p95 ~420ms. Trending steadily.
Maria: good to see. I'll prepare a short customer note and slack DM the two affected accounts.
Grace (SRE): I'm going to shadow for handoff. Sam, when you want to escalate to incident, say so — otherwise we'll track as SLO-mitigation and do a follow-up RCA.
Sam H: agree — keeping as mitigation-only for now. We'll keep PD open. If p99 stays <1.2s for 20m, we'll close paging.
Lee: one more action: add a KV eviction-rate alert to avoid thrash loops — threshold at 200 evictions/min.
Sam H: copying runbook snippet for followup:
```text
Action items postmortem:
- verify background job scheduling that caused memory pressure
- investigate why batch warm-up coincided with hotkey traffic spike
- consider autoscaler hysteresis to avoid oscillation during short bursts
- add synthetic large-prompt tests to performance suite
```
ops-bot: PD note: INC-8123 acknowledged by Sam H, L2 escalation window set to 15m.
Sam H: p99 steady at ~800ms for 10m. I'm going to hand this to Grace for the monitoring + RCA path.
Grace (SRE): ack. I'll own the follow-up and will schedule an RCA. Handing off to oncall-next for daytime monitoring.
Maria: sending customer DM now.
Sam H: thanks team. Closing live mitigation thread — keeping PD incident open for RCA tracking.
Grace (SRE): tagging for follow-up: @product, @eng-runtime, @eng-ml. I'll drop a summary in #incidents after RCA is scheduled.
